scope: Independent test-only native IndexedDB receipt oracle; no user-flow or browser/model quality claim.

testCases: native CAS: two accepted instances race, exactly one complete graph wins without losing PCM
native legacy load: complete descriptor and Blob bytes stay untouched until an accepted edit
native authority: an unaccepted newer load cannot silently authorize overwriting another writer
native failed hash read does not erase earlier authority or adopt the damaged snapshot
native presence: proven absence permits first save, present undefined remains protected
native private receipts: cloned, foreign and consumed replacement receipts never grant write authority
native replacement CAS: a winner written after review invalidates that exact reviewed receipt
native transaction rollback: abort after put success leaves graph and expected receipt unchanged for retry
native input atomicity: invalid bundle and save before acceptance cannot clear retained audio

method.fixtureSeeding: Original literal descriptors and 16-byte PCM written through genuine browser IndexedDB; expectations authored before producer implementation inspection.
method.harness: Gated test-only entry exposes only ReferenceStorage and SavedCopyConflict; no production globals or mocked database.
method.comparison: Native readonly snapshot plus independent SHA-256 of all retained Blob bytes; assertions compare literal document/PCM expectations.
method.concurrency: Two independent ReferenceStorage instances accept the same real saved snapshot and concurrently save different complete bundles; exactly one wins, loser is SavedCopyConflict, only winner PCM remains.
method.rollback: Pass-through native IDBObjectStore.put returns the real request; its success listener aborts the real owning transaction before complete. Durable row/assets and authority remain unchanged, then retry succeeds.
covered: Unaccepted newer load cannot adopt authority
Failed PCM hash load preserves accepted authority
Reviewed replacement stale after winner write
Invalid input and save before accepted load leave graph intact
limitations: Tiny original PCM fixtures test identity and atomic storage, not maximum media capacity or audible accuracy.
Controlled transaction abort is declared fault injection; requests, transactions, reads and stored Blob bytes remain native.
This nine-case harness does not replace the separate native UI conflict/lifecycle acceptance.

fixtures.serializationForLiteralBundleHash: UTF-8 compact JSON, recursively sorted keys; assets include numeric pcm arrays. Test-only representation, not a production encoder or portable-file hash.

cleanup: Playwright runner and its browser exited; no owned server was started. Root-owned 4300 remained running and slot was released.
